description: Implement the restore-side operator workflow: backup catalogs, integrity verification, restore ordering, destination selection, dry-run safety checks, and operator-facing API/CLI/UI surfaces. The end state should give self-hosted Vrooli operators a credible answer for full-system recovery after disk loss, machine migration, or major operator error.
name: data-backup-manager-restore-catalog-and-operator-surfaces
title: Build restore catalog and operator surfaces for Data Backup Manager
